import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import RFE
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Generate classification dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=200, n_features=10, n_informative=5, random_state=42)
feature_names = [f'feature_{i}' for i in range(10)]

# Create an RFE wrapper with LogisticRegression
rfe = RFE(estimator=LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000), n_features_to_select=5)

# Fit RFE and get the ranking of each feature
rfe.fit(X, y)

# Print feature rankings and identify the selected features
ranking_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'feature': feature_names,
    'ranking': rfe.ranking_,
    'selected': rfe.support_
}).sort_values('ranking')

print("Feature Rankings (1 = selected):")
print(ranking_df.to_string(index=False))

# Print the transformed dataset with only selected features
X_selected = rfe.transform(X)
print(f"\nSelected features: {np.array(feature_names)[rfe.support_].tolist()}")
print(f"Transformed shape: {X_selected.shape}")
